answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Activation measurements match fine-tuned: layer-1 L2 of 0.084 is close to the 0.086-0.092 range, and layer 16 (0.189) and layer 32 (0.414) fit. The final-layer jump is +0.117, the mid-layer size ratio 1.021 (the state grows), effective rank 3.12 and direction consistency 0.705 are all in range. Median first divergence of 10 is a bit high but close to the fine-tuned range, and top-1 agreement 0.938 and raw-score shift/TV 11.5 are at the edge of the fine-tuned range. Quantized is ruled out because the size ratio is above 1, layer 1 is lower than the quantized range, direction consistency is high, and the final-layer jump and effective rank are wrong. System-prompted is ruled out because first divergence is not 0, edit distance is 0.53 rather than about 0.8, the layer-2 spike is 0.1 rather than 30+, and layer-16 L2 is only 0.189. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
